name: box-sides-field
title: Box sides field
description: Edit padding or margin on four sides: a small box with a number on each edge and a link in the middle that moves all four at once.
docs: value is { top, right, bottom, left } and onValueChange is also told whether the sides are linked. With the link on, changing one side sets all four. sides={2} shows a vertical and a horizontal field and mirrors them on the other two edges. The sides are checked as they are typed, the arrow keys step the side the cursor is in (Shift for ten steps), and Tab goes clockwise from the top. Each number is a spin button read as 'Padding top, 16 pixels', and the link is a real toggle named 'Link all sides'. The box is 254px wide and narrows with its container (the number boxes go from 72px to 56px below 238px), down to about 200px, so it fits a small phone and an editor's inspector.
